function Row({id}) {  const entity = use(s.entities.get(id));  const selected = use(s.selected) === id;  const matches = matchesFilter(entity.label, use(s.filter));  const expanded = use(s.expanded).has(id);  let details = null;  let children = null;  if (expanded) {    if (s.detailsMode === 'component') {      children = <Details />;    } else {      // Read conditionally: rows that aren't expanded don't subscribe.      details = use(s.details);    }  }  return (    <RowView      label={entity.label}      x={entity.x}      y={entity.y}      color={entity.color}      selected={selected}      matches={matches}      details={details}>      {children}    </RowView>  );}
function App() {  const n = use(count);  return (    <button onClick={() => count.update(x => x + 1)}>      Clicked {n} times    </button>  );}
